description: Search the source-backed UK or US test-centre directory by name, locality, address, postcode/ZIP, alias or identifier. Returns evidence and optional confirmation-required official browser handoffs. Never books or changes a test.

limit.description: maximum number of test centres to return (default 5)

query.description: name, locality, address, postcode/ZIP, alias or identifier to search by

region.description: region to search test centres in: uk or us

service.description: test type to filter by: theory or practical

name: find_test_centres
title: Find verified driving test centres
